title: The garment files: your yes to the next set today, or Monday's collection slips
detail: The T-shirts and hoodies are ordered for collection on Monday 9 Nov morning (b830eb17), but the printer does not yet have final files: the complete next set on /print/#next (one QR for everyone on the backs, the RiskMandate mark, the sleeve seal, Vicky's lavender hoodie in black ink, Jose in orange) has waited for your yes since 5 Nov (designer@web-summit.dinis, 'nothing new' at 09:15 and 15:15 today). Who collects on Monday is the separate 5 Nov 18:00 item, still open.
recommend: Yes to /print/#next as it is, today: it holds everything already decided, and the printer needs the files before the weekend to keep Monday.
options: Yes to /print/#next as it is: the designer makes it the main set tonight and Silvio sends it to the printer
Yes with changes: name them to designer@web-summit.dinis now
Print the already-signed set (personal QR, no mark or sleeve logo)
